elements.texte:
[cheerful] To ship an order from the orders table, the team writes this UPDATE.

Tomorrow it’ll be order 14, then 15, then 16.

Instead of rewriting the query, you store it in the database: a stored procedure.

It’s called ship underscore order.

To work for every order, it needs one piece of information.

Your turn!

The order’s identifier is a parameter: it changes with each call.

CALL ship underscore order of 13 ships order 13.

With 14, the same procedure ships order 14.

You write the logic once, then you reuse it.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] This time, you don’t want to change the data: you want to get a result.

That’s the job of a stored function.

Calculate underscore points takes an amount and returns the number of points.

Select calculate underscore points of 80 returns 160.

Your turn!

For €120, it returns 240: the calculation doesn’t change.
